title: Lipidomic Analysis of Neuronal Lipid Droplets
author: Mukesh Kumar
materials: Process the LC-MS data using MS-DIAL software (version 4.7; PMID: 25938372).

steps.title: Prepare LD samples
steps.instruction: Thaw the lipid droplet (LD) samples on ice and homogenize them.

steps.title: Extract lipids
steps.instruction: Perform lipid extraction using MTBE and internal standards.

substeps.instruction: Add MTBE and spiked Avanti Splashmix (internal standards) to the samples
Centrifuge the mixture to separate the organic phase
Carefully collect the organic phase, ensuring no contamination from the aqueous phase

steps.title: Dry and resuspend extract
steps.instruction: Remove solvent and resuspend the lipid extract.

substeps.instruction: Dry the organic phase under a gentle stream of nitrogen or in a vacuum concentrator
Resuspend the dried lipid extract in 1-Butanol
Vortex the sample to ensure uniform suspension

steps.title: Configure LC-MS system
steps.instruction: Set up the chromatography and mass spectrometry hardware.

substeps.instruction: Install an Agilent Poroshell 120 EC-C18 column (2.7 μm, 2.1 × 100 mm) on an Agilent 1290 Infinity II LC system
Prepare Mobile Phase A (60% Acetonitrile, 40% H₂O, 7.5 mM Ammonium Acetate)
Prepare Mobile Phase B (90% IPA, 10% Acetonitrile, 7.5 mM Ammonium Acetate)
Prepare an Agilent Quadrupole Time-Of-Flight 6546 mass spectrometer for high-resolution detection

steps.title: Run LC-MS analysis
steps.instruction: Load the sample and execute the separation gradient.

substeps.instruction: Load 3 µL of the lipid mixture onto the LC-MS system
Run gradient: 85% A (15% B) decreasing to 70% A over 00:02:00
Reduce to 1% A within 00:01:00 and hold for 00:04:00
Restore gradient to 85% A and wash the column for 00:05:00

steps.title: Identify and quantify lipids
steps.instruction: Process the resulting data to determine lipid species and concentrations.

substeps.instruction: Identify lipid species based on mass spectra and retention times
Quantify each lipid species using the moles of corresponding class-specific lipid standards present in the Splashmix
